headline: Pouliot pool, CPA Application 2026, and C.P.A. and CDBG projects are on the agenda, along with a Halloween event and permitting.
summary: The agenda lists the Pouliot pool and a CPA Application for 2026. It also covers permitting, a Halloween event, Suburban Basketball, and department goals.
location: Parks and Recreation Office, City Hall, 536 Dwight Street, Holyoke
